mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM cs_agent a INNER JOIN cs_agent_skill ask ON a.id = ask.agent_id WHERE ask.skill_group_id = #{skillGroupId} AND a.status = 'ONLINE' AND a.current_load < a.max_concurrent ORDER BY (a.max_concurrent - a.current_load) DESC, ask.proficiency DESC
SELECT * FROM cs_agent WHERE status IN ('ONLINE', 'BUSY')
mapper.update: UPDATE cs_agent SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE cs_agent SET current_load = current_load + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE cs_agent SET current_load = GREATEST(current_load - 1, 0), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE cs_agent SET max_concurrent = #{maxConcurrent}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE cs_agent SET last_online_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cs_agent (username, display_name, status, max_concurrent, current_load, is_supervisor) VALUES (#{username}, #{displayName}, #{status}, #{maxConcurrent}, #{currentLoad}, #{isSupervisor})
